title: Communication effects
body: Delay, loss, partial fields, and garble change what reaches a seat. The profile preview is illustrative; the current player still uses scripted delivery rules.

title: Source grades
body: A source grade describes the report source, not whether the report is correct. Compare it with other evidence before acting.

title: Truth and perception
body: Trainees see their own reports. The instructor and AAR can compare that picture with the separate scripted truth stream.

title: Deadlines and defaults
body: A decision point can name a default for a missed deadline. This local preview shows the stated default but does not run a live deadline clock.

title: The after-action review
body: Review the reports available at the decision point, then compare them with scripted truth and discuss what could have changed the picture.
